name: a note and an invoice light up their matching phrases
looks: A handwritten-style field note sits beside a formal invoice. A phrase in the note underlines in the accent colour, a beat later the matching line item in the invoice highlights too, as if a thread connects them, while most of the invoice sits dim, unconnected to anything.
build: Each document is real DOM text; highlights are background/text-decoration tweens (power2.out, 0.15-0.2s); the matched invoice span highlights one beat after the note's phrase, same mechanic as text-diff-highlight.
sound: A soft highlighter-pen tick per phrase, a slightly different pitch for the invoice's half of each pair.
prompt: Sit a handwritten-style note beside a formal invoice, highlight a phrase in the note, then highlight its matching line item in the invoice a beat later as if a thread connects them, while most of the invoice stays dim and unconnected, to make the gap between the two documents visible.
